_description: Industria alimentare (CNEL E012) level 4, June 2026 regular run, permanent, full time: the tranche of 1 January 2026.
_notes: Minimo tabellare level 4 (parameter 120): 1,393.10 from 1 January 2025 and 1,445.65 from 1 January 2026 (CCNL 1 March 2024, Art. 51 lett. A, column 'Nuovi minimi dal 1/01/2026').
Contingenza 519.99 (Art. 52), EDR 10.33 for 13 months (Art. 52) and IAR 78.84 from 1 December 2023 (Art. 51 lett. D) are separate items.
Base salary only: the allowances, Art. 51 bis and the gross depend on facts outside the national table.
